gloss: to leave as is; to defer; to keep unchanged

definitions.gloss: to leave as is; to keep unchanged; to hold at the current level
definitions.explanation: To maintain something at its current state or level without changing it. Commonly used for prices, interest rates, taxes, and other quantitative measures that could be raised or lowered.

examples.japanese: {金利|きんり}を{据|す}え{置|お}く。
{今年度|こんねんど}は{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}を{据|す}え{置|お}くことが{決|き}まった。
examples.english: It was decided to keep tuition fees unchanged this fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}は{政策|せいさく}{金利|きんり}を{現行|げんこう}の{水準|すいじゅん}に{据|す}え{置|お}くことを{全会|ぜんかい}{一致|いっち}で{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan unanimously decided to keep the policy interest rate at its current level.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Godan verb (か row): {据|す}え{置|お}く・{据|す}え{置|お}きます
て-form: {据|す}え{置|お}いて
た-form: {据|す}え{置|お}いた

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金利|きんり}を{据|す}え{置|お}く (to hold interest rates steady)
- {価格|かかく}を{据|す}え{置|お}く (to keep prices unchanged)
- {税率|ぜいりつ}を{据|す}え{置|お}く (to maintain the tax rate)
- {据|す}え{置|お}き{期間|きかん} (grace period; deferment period)

RELATED FORMS:
- {据|す}え{置|お}き (noun form) — often used in compound phrases like {据|す}え{置|お}き{型|がた} (stationary type) or {据|す}え{置|お}き{期間|きかん} (deferment period).

USAGE:
Primarily used in financial, economic, and policy contexts. Very common in news reporting about central bank decisions and pricing.
